::: {.threshold data-label="In short"}
:::

**Education.** PhD in Statistics, Baylor University, 2026 (advisor: John W. Seaman Jr.).
MS in Statistics, Baylor University, 2023. BS in Statistics, Baylor University, 2022,
magna cum laude.

**Positions.** Biostatistics intern, AstraZeneca, Late Respiratory and Immunology
Statistics, summer 2025. Biostatistics intern, Baylor Scott &amp; White Health, 2024 to
2026. Statistical consultant, Baylor University Statistical Consulting Center, 2024.
Data Science Fellow, MoWaTER program, 2022.

**Methods.** Bayesian inference and prior specification, ICH E9(R1) estimands and
intercurrent event strategies, clinical trial design and simulation, sample size and
power, causal inference and G-computation, survival and longitudinal analysis, missing
data and multiple imputation, pharmacokinetic AUC estimation, functional data analysis.

**Software.** R (Stan, JAGS, tidyverse, Shiny, Quarto), SAS, Python, SQL, Git, LaTeX.
